confidence_notes: Recent Lima price aggregates support the meal, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer estimates. The cocktail estimate uses a current crowd-sourced downtown-club price (about four times the local draft beer price); the wine-glass estimate is inferred at about twice the local beer price. Accommodation estimates are holistic and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No explicit comparable city was used. Dining anchors follow Lima-specific aggregates; accommodation anchors use general knowledge for a large Latin American capital with substantial tourism.
